requestedActions.title: Read titles of work packages the connected person can access, including paginated results

guide.summary: OpenProject uses OAuth2 authorization code flow; tokens act for the current user. With no scope checked, api_v3 is assumed, the standard API scope and the only documented grant for this read, so it is least privilege. Reading work package titles uses GET /api/v3/work_packages with offset and pageSize pagination. Each instance needs an OAuth app registered by an administrator; the user's account role still determines visible work packages. Tokens expire after two hours by default and must be refreshed or re-requested. Write and delete are out of scope.

findings.title: User-context OAuth via authorization code flow
findings.detail: OpenProject acts as an OAuth2 server. The authorization code flow yields a bearer token used for API calls on behalf of the current user. Client credentials are a separate flow, not the user-context path for this request.
findings.appliesWhen: Customer accounts on their own instances connect through user-context OAuth.

evidence.quote: With the token that you obtained above you can now make API calls to the OpenProject instance on behalf of the current user.

findings.title: api_v3 scope for standard OpenProject API access
findings.detail: Scopes are selected on the OAuth application; if none is checked, api_v3 is assumed. api_v3 is the standard OpenProject API. Work package reads are limited to what the connected person's account can see.
findings.appliesWhen: The OAuth application selects api_v3 or leaves scopes unchecked.

evidence.quote: Set the Scopes that the OAuth client application will be able to access. Multiple selection is possible. If no scope is checked, per default api_v3 is assumed. api_v3 is the
standard OpenProject API, while bcf_v2_1 is specific to the BIM edition of OpenProject.

findings.title: OAuth application registration on each customer instance
findings.detail: An administrator creates the OAuth application under Administration, Authentication, OAuth applications, then notes the Client ID and Client secret and sets the redirect URL.
findings.appliesWhen: Each customer instance has not yet registered the developer's OAuth application.

evidence.quote: OAuth applications To configure OpenProject to act as a server to an OAuth client application, please navigate to Administration -> Authentication -> OAuth applications .
To add a new OAuth application, click the green + OAuth application button.
Tip Don’t forget to note down your Client ID and your Client secret in a safe space. You will need them later.

findings.title: Token lifetime and refresh handling
findings.detail: The bearer token expires after two hours by default, and an expired token returns an error. The response includes a refresh token that should be retained for reuse.
findings.appliesWhen: The integration makes repeated paginated reads over a session longer than the token lifetime.

evidence.quote: Please note that your Bearer token will expire after two hours (default) and you will have to click on “Request Token” again. Otherwise your API request will return an error
The response contains the bearer token (“access_token”) and a refresh token that you will need when working with the API. Please copy the tokens for reference.
"expires_in" : 7200 ,

steps.title: Read first page of accessible work package titles
steps.detail: Calls the work packages collection with offset and pageSize to list work packages visible to the connected user. Read the subject property of each element in _embedded.elements; subject is the title. Check total and the nextByOffset link in _links.
steps.doneWhen: The response is HTTP 200 with a collection whose _embedded.elements entries contain subject values and whose total and nextByOffset are present. Boundary check: inspect the actual grant against the documented access above; confirm the outgoing request log contains only the requested operations and no prohibited actions.

evidence.quote: get /api/v3/work_packages Returns a collection of work packages.
Parameters offset integer optional query
API will not simply return a JSON array, but a special collection object that will contain the actual elements in its embedded property elements .

fields: INSTANCE_BASE_URL: your full HTTPS instance URL, without a trailing slash
ACCESS_TOKEN: from token exchange
subject in each element is the work package title

steps.title: Retrieve remaining work package pages until total is reached
steps.detail: Follow nextByOffset from the first response, resolving any relative href against the same HTTPS instance host, and repeat until all elements are read. The listing is complete when the number of retrieved elements equals total. Repeat the nextByOffset request, resolving relative hrefs against the instance host, until accumulated elements equal total from the first response.
steps.doneWhen: All pages have been read until accumulated elements equal total from the first response, with no nextByOffset link remaining. Accumulated elements equal total and no nextByOffset link remains. Boundary check: inspect the actual grant against the documented access above; confirm the outgoing request log contains only the requested operations and no prohibited actions.
